constraint: Create a completely new composition; never reuse or edit attempt-001. Preserve every base card contract and both recurring identities. Show exactly two clothed adults and exactly one inanimate horned stone statue. Show exactly two bright thick cords total, one per adult. Each cord must be continuously traceable at 140×196 from one separate open stone guide low on the statue base, forward around that adult's clothed mid-torso as one huge visibly slack open loop with hand-width clearance, and into that same adult's visible natural hand lifting the loop outward to step free. Both loops still encircle their own torso while visibly loose and immediately removable; they are not detached handheld rope coils. No cord crosses to the other adult. No cord wraps, restrains or tightens a neck, collar, wrist, hand, ankle or limb; only the lifting grasp touches a hand. Show no knot, lock, chain, cuff, shackle, cage, third person, animal, extra rope, flame, wing, living demon, pentagram, inverted star, rune, glyph, text, wheel, crossing, water, bird, sun or lion.

A fresh composition must make both continuous loose self-removable bonds legible without coercion.
